description:
**Company Description** 

BrightCHAMPS is a global edtech platform focused on bridging the gap between traditional education and the real\-world skills children need to thrive. The company offers expert\-designed courses in Coding, Financial Literacy, Math, Robotics, AI, Communication, and other future\-ready domains across more than 30 countries, delivering over 200,000 live classes every month. Backed by $63M in funding and valued at $650M, BrightCHAMPS is trusted by parents, educators, and learners worldwide and has received multiple “Startup of the Year” recognitions. Founded by educator and entrepreneur Ravi Bhushan, whose leadership has earned several “CEO of the Year” awards, the organization is committed to making high\-quality education accessible to all. Team members join a collaborative, impact\-driven culture that empowers young minds and supports a vision of becoming the world’s most trusted education platform.

**Role Description** 

This is an on\-site internship role based in Bengaluru for a Talent Acquisition Intern. The intern will support end\-to\-end hiring activities, including sourcing candidates, screening resumes, coordinating interviews, and maintaining candidate pipelines. Daily responsibilities include assisting with job postings, updating applicant tracking systems, communicating with candidates and hiring managers, and helping organize recruitment drives or campus hiring events. The intern will also contribute to employer branding initiatives, such as crafting recruitment messages, supporting social media campaigns, and representing BrightCHAMPS at events when needed. This internship offers hands\-on experience in modern talent acquisition practices within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven edtech environment.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Full\-life Cycle Recruiting and Recruiting, including sourcing, screening, and coordinating the selection process.
* Candidates should possess skills in Interviewing and Hiring, with the ability to support structured interview processes and evaluation documentation.
* Candidates should possess skills in Employer Branding, helping promote BrightCHAMPS as an employer of choice through content, events, and candidate engagement.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates, hiring managers, and external partners.
* High level of organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Comfort with using HR tools, applicant tracking systems, and spreadsheets; proficiency in MS Office or Google Workspace is preferred.
* Current enrollment in or recent completion of a degree program in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field is preferred, but not strictly required.
* Interest in the edtech sector and passion for supporting a mission\-driven organization focused on empowering children through education.

title: Intern, Talent Acquisition Operations
description:
### **Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.**



At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.



Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.



If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

 **Location:** This is an onsite role based at Nextiva’s Bengaluru office (Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048\). Working together onsite strengthens how we operate, enabling faster decisions, clearer communication, and stronger execution, so you can make a greater impact and move work forward with speed and clarity.


**In\-Office Expectation:** This role is expected to work onsite five days per week, supporting a highly collaborative, in\-person team environment.



Nextiva’s Talent Acquisition team brings great people and opportunities together, building the teams that move our business forward. As a Talent Acquisition Operations Intern, you’ll play an important role in creating a smooth, thoughtful experience for candidates, from coordinating interviews across teams and time zones, to keeping candidates informed and engaged throughout the hiring process.



You’ll get hands\-on experience with the systems, processes, data, and AI\-enabled tools behind a modern recruiting function, while contributing ideas that make hiring simpler and more effective. Along the way, you’ll partner with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, global TA Operations, and the broader People Team, gaining exposure to the way a global Talent Acquisition team operates across India, the United States, Mexico, and Europe.



**What You’ll Do**



**Recruiting Coordination**


* Coordinate interviews across candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interview teams.
* Manage scheduling, rescheduling, calendar invitations, and candidate communications across global time zones.
* Provide backup support to TA Operations teams in the US \& Mexico, as needed.
* Support virtual and onsite interview logistics.
* Help ensure candidates have a smooth and professional interview experience.
* Maintain accurate candidate and interview information in Greenhouse or other recruiting systems.


**Talent Acquisition Operations**


* Support day\-to\-day TA Operations activities and recruiting processes across multiple regions.
* Maintain recruiting templates, trackers, documentation, and process resources.
* Assist with pre\-employment activities such as offer documentation and onboarding coordination.
* Support pre\-onboarding candidate engagement to help create a positive experience between offer acceptance and start date.
* Support recruiting data audits and help keep candidate, requisition, and process information accurate and up to date.
* Provide support for internship program administration and other Talent Acquisition operational activities.
* Assist with local and regional recruiting activities based on business needs.


**AI \& Process Improvement**


* Use approved AI tools to support research, drafting, documentation, analysis, and day\-to\-day recruiting tasks.
* Help identify opportunities to simplify recruiting processes and reduce manual work.
* Support updates to workflows, templates, candidate communications, and recruiting documentation.
* Review AI\-generated content for accuracy, relevance, and quality before use.
* Learn how AI and automation can be applied responsibly within Talent Acquisition.


**Projects, Reporting \& Documentation**


* Support Talent Acquisition projects, recruiting programs, and process improvement initiatives.
* Assist with recruiting reports, trackers, dashboards, and basic data analysis.
* Help create and update SOPs, playbooks, process documentation, and recruiting resources.
* Support employer branding, recruiting events, campus or early\-career initiatives, and other Talent Acquisition programs as needed.
* Assist with ad hoc TA projects and cross\-functional initiatives based on team and business priorities.


✨ **Candidate Experience, Employer Brand \& Local Engagement**


* Provide timely and thoughtful communication to candidates throughout the recruiting process.
* Help create a consistent and positive candidate experience from scheduling through onboarding.
* Support pre\-onboarding engagement and candidate touchpoints prior to joining.
* Represent Nextiva professionally when interacting with candidates and external talent.
* Support local employer branding, recruiting events, social media initiatives, and talent attraction activities as needed.
* Assist with employee engagement, culture\-building, and People Team activities where appropriate.
* Support other local and regional Talent Acquisition or People Team initiatives based on business needs.


**What We’re Looking For**


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree, Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
* Interest in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting Operations, or People Operations.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable working with calendars, spreadsheets, documents, and collaboration tools.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools personally, academically, or professionally.
* Curiosity and willingness to use approved AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar technologies to support research, communication, documentation, and day\-to\-day productivity.
* Willingness to learn new recruiting systems, tools, and processes.
* Ability to work collaboratively with individuals across teams, countries, and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to work outside standard business hours as needed to support recruiting activities, interview coordination, and TA Operations in a global environment.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling candidate and confidential information.
* Able to attend occasional meetings outside of normal business hours with Global team members as needed.


**Nice to Have**


* Previous internship, work, volunteer, or academic experience related to Recruiting.
* Familiarity with Greenhouse or another Applicant Tracking System.
* Experience coordinating meetings, interviews, events, or calendars.
* Exposure to Excel, reporting, data tracking, or process documentation.


**Nextiva DNA** (Core Competencies)



Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:


* **Drives Results**: Action\-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and **simplicity** to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
* **Critical Thinker:** Data\-driven, **forward\-thinking** individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision\-making, and focus on higher\-value work.
* **Right Attitude:** Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and **care** for customers and teammates.


**Total Rewards**



Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.



Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.


* **Medical** \- Medical insurance coverage is available for employees, their spouse, and up to two dependent children with a limit of 500,000 INR, as well as their parents or in\-laws for up to 300,000 INR. This comprehensive coverage ensures that essential healthcare needs are met for the entire family unit, providing peace of mind and security in times of medical necessity.

* **Financial Security**\- Provident Fund \& Gratuity

title: HR recruiter cum Trainer
description:
**Job Opening: HR Recruiter cum Trainer (Investment Banking \& Trade Products)Company:** Dulcet Holdings India Private Limited  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)  
**Experience Level:** 3 to 6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About Dulcet H**oldings: Dulcet Holdings India Private Limited is a premier financial services and investment operations firm. We are scaling our high\-performing Investment Banking and Capital Markets teams in india. We are looking for an agile **HR Recruiter cum Trainer** who can bridge the gap between acquiring top\-tier financial talent and preparing them for operational excellence in core banking and institutional market products.

**Role O**verview: This is a high\-visibility, dual\-impact role. You will own the full\-lifecycle recruitment for niche financial profiles and simultaneously design and deliver domain\-specific onboarding, technical workflows, and soft\-skills training programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Talent Acquisition:** Source, screen, and hire niche professionals across Investment Banking (Corporate Finance, M\&A, Equity Research) and
* **Global Trade Products** (Trade Finance, Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Document Collections, Supply Chain Finance, and Cross\-Border Payments).
* **Pipeline Management:** Leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, and financial networks to maintain a warm talent pipeline within the competitive Bengaluru hub.
* **Onboarding \& Technical Training Delivery:** Facilitate comprehensive induction modules covering basic financial concepts, capital markets infrastructure, corporate valuation toolkits, compliance, and structural workflows of transactional trade finance products.
* **Talent Development:** Conduct training needs analysis (TNA) and execute workshops for soft skills, business communication, and leadership alignment.
* **Metric Tracking:** Monitor key metrics like time\-to\-hire, post\-training assessment scores, and early\-stage candidate retention.

**Probation Period Policy**

* **Duration:** All new hires will undergo a mandatory **6\-month probation period** from their date of joining.
* **Evaluation:** Performance, adaptability, and culture\-fit will be reviewed at the end of the 1, 2, 3rd and 5th months.
* **Confirmation:** Upon successful completion of the 6\-month period and meeting all baseline KPIs, the employee will receive a formal Letter of Confirmation. The probation period may be extended up to a maximum of 3 additional months at the management's discretion if performance benchmarks are not fully met.
* **Mandatory Legal \& Compliance F**ramework. At Dulcet Holdings, we operate under a strict code of ethics and corporate governance.
* **Strict Legal Alignment:** Every internal company policy, code of conduct, and operational workflow strictly adheres to the local laws of Bengaluru, the Government of Karnataka, and the Government of India (including statutory regulations governed by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, SEBI, RBI guidelines on Trade/Forex, and Central Labour Laws).
* **Policy Rejection \& Precedence:** Any internal company policy, practice, or operational mandate that is found to cross, conflict with, or contradict government regulations, statutory compliance requirements, or employee rights under Indian law will be **automatically deemed null, void, and rejected**. Government laws and statutory regulations will permanently take absolute legal precedence over internal company guidelines under all circumstances.

**Candidate Eligibility Criteria**

* **Education:** Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Human Resources, Finance, or Business Administration (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* **Experience:** 3 to 6 years of proven experience combining recruitment and training functions inside an Investment Bank, KPO, Global Capability Center (GCC), or Corporate/Transaction Banking setup.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Strong foundational understanding of Investment Banking products, financial modelling basics, and
* **Trade Finance products** (PID, SID, vendor finance etc ).
* **Tools:** Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), and advanced Excel/PowerPoint.

**Compensation \& CTC S**tructure:

We offer a competitive package ranging from **₹6,00,000 to ₹9,50,000 per annum**, structured to reward high performance:

* **Fixed Base Salary (80%):** Standard assured monthly salary (inclusive of Basic, HRA, PF, and statutory allowances).
* **Recruitment Performance Bonus (15%):** Paid out quarterly based on mandate fulfillment, time\-to\-hire efficiency, and 90\-day candidate retention.
* **Training Incentive (5%):** Tied to successful batch onboarding timelines and post\-training assessment pass rates.

**Performance Framework \& PIP P**olicy: Performance is formally audited on a quarterly basis against clear benchmarks:

* **Hiring Funnel:** Maintaining a minimum 85% achievement rate on monthly sourcing and onboarding mandates.
* **Training Pass Rate:** Ensuring a minimum 80% average score on post\-onboarding technical evaluations (covering IB basics and Trade operations).
* **Retention Rate:** Maintaining early\-stage candidate attrition below 8% within the first 60 days.

**30\-Day PIP Policy:** If a confirmed team member fails to meet at least 70% of their combined recruitment and training KPIs for two consecutive quarters, or shows significant gaps in process compliance, they will be placed on a structured **30\-day Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)**. This period includes dedicated weekly mentorship and clear milestones. Successful completion restores normal standing, while failure to meet the PIP metrics will result in exit separation. *(Note: The PIP policy applies strictly to confirmed employees; performance shortfalls during the initial Probation Period are handled under standard probation review terms).*

**How to A**pply: If you are a blended HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced investment and transactional banking ecosystem, we want to hear from you!

**Send your updated resume to:** hr@dulcetholding.com  
**Subject Line:** Application: HR Recruiter cum Trainer (IB \& Trade) \- Bengaluru

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

* Internet reimbursement
* Work from home
